plan: Given my value of $40, I should bid below this to ensure profit if I win. Bidding exactly $40 or more risks zero or negative profit. I will bid slightly less than $40, such as $39.9, to maximize my chance of winning while ensuring profit, as paying the third-highest bid should be less than my value. This strategy avoids dominated bids by ensuring potential profit.

Given my value of $13, bidding above this would risk a loss if I win, as I would pay more than the value. Bidding exactly $13 may not be optimal if others bid higher. A bid slightly below $13, like $12.9, could win if others bid low, while minimizing potential loss. Since this is a single round, maximizing profit means avoiding overbidding.
